name: aigovops
description: The AiGovOps Foundation's skills, scoped by department — governed procedure a volunteer can install in one command.

plugins.name: aigovops-governance
plugins.description: Map a problem to the frameworks that govern it, sign the evidence, and check what ships. Everyone loads this one.

plugins.name: aigovops-editorial
plugins.description: Write, document and translate in the Foundation's voice — and check prose against it before it carries the Foundation's name.

plugins.name: aigovops-community
plugins.description: Announce the monthly session, report what shipped, and draft for sponsors — each from facts that already exist.

plugins.name: aigovops-design
plugins.description: Apply the estate's design system and specify a flow before anyone builds it.

plugins.name: aigovops-estate
plugins.description: Watch the estate: the hourly interaction board, and alerting that pauses rather than guesses.

plugins.name: aigovops-operator
plugins.description: Skills that reach a release path or send mail as the Foundation. Red-classed: never run unattended. Installs DISABLED — a founder or steward turns it on deliberately, per install.
